ModMetaData.name: RimUtinni: Ship Memory — the Chains Below
ModMetaData.author: Mandrake
ModMetaData.description: ANOMALY_EXCEPTION_ACCESS_1 — the Memory-Core revelation. The owner cut the player's research route into the Anomaly containment/bioferrite economy, not the content itself ("I did not cut the anomaly content. I only cut the players ability to research that tech tree." — 2026-09-03). This mod grants access the ruled way: a `discoveryPrerequisites` reveal gate, not a hidden research row. Patches HoldingPlatform, ElectricInhibitor, ShardInhibitor, BioferriteHarvester, Electroharvester, BioferriteGenerator and BioferritePlate to drop their vanilla researchPrerequisites and gate on one never-spawned key item instead (RUT_ShipMemory_Containment). A single GameComponent reveals all seven the moment the clan ties down its first live beast, stockpiles 50+ Bioferrite, or the Assailant dungeon's core signals it — one `ChoiceLetter`, no quest, no research tab entry. Full spec: design/Jawa/anomaly_exception_access_spec.md.
